title: Responsible Release of AI-Generated Mathematics
title_zh: 负责任发布AI生成数学成果的方法

paragraphs.en: At present, some frontier AI labs are testing advanced mathematical problems on proprietary models that remain inaccessible to the broader scientific community. Our recommendations are formulated with this practical context in mind. However, ideally, they would not do so. We want to state clearly from the start: we do not endorse this practice, and we ask them to stop testing advanced mathematical problems on proprietary models.
paragraphs.zh: 目前，一些前沿 AI 实验室正在专有模型上测试高难度数学问题，而这些模型是更广泛的科学界无法访问的。 我们的建议是在考虑这一现实背景的基础上制定的。 然而，理想情况下，他们不应这样做。 我们想从一开始就明确声明：我们不认可这种做法，并要求他们停止在专有模型上测试高难度数学问题。

sents.en: At present, some frontier AI labs are testing advanced mathematical problems on proprietary models that remain inaccessible to the broader scientific community.
sents.zh: 目前，一些前沿 AI 实验室正在专有模型上测试高难度数学问题，而这些模型是更广泛的科学界无法访问的。

sents.en: Our recommendations are formulated with this practical context in mind.
sents.zh: 我们的建议是在考虑这一现实背景的基础上制定的。

sents.en: However, ideally, they would not do so.
sents.zh: 然而，理想情况下，他们不应这样做。

sents.en: We want to state clearly from the start: we do not endorse this practice, and we ask them to stop testing advanced mathematical problems on proprietary models.
sents.zh: 我们想从一开始就明确声明：我们不认可这种做法，并要求他们停止在专有模型上测试高难度数学问题。

paragraphs.en: The mathematical community has long-standing norms concerning the dissemination and peer review of results. These norms have been essential for the reliability, trustworthiness, and effectiveness of mathematical work. One of the most important scholarly norms in mathematics is that the authors of a paper should understand the mathematical argument of that paper, have verified its correctness themselves, and take full responsibility for the content. Moreover, in the mathematical community, authors of works that significantly advance the field regularly give seminars at other institutions and talks at conferences, explaining their new developments and answering questions from colleagues. This all works towards developing the deepest possible human understanding of mathematics, which is one of the crowning glories of millennia of human development.
paragraphs.zh: 数学界长期以来一直存在关于成果传播与同行评审的规范。 这些规范对于数学工作的可靠性、可信性和有效性至关重要。 数学中最重要的学术规范之一是：论文作者应当理解该论文的数学论证，亲自验证其正确性，并对内容承担全部责任。 此外，在数学界，做出重大推进该领域工作的作者通常会定期在其他机构举办研讨会并在会议上作报告，解释他们的新进展并回答同行的问题。 这一切都有助于发展对数学尽可能深入的人类理解，而这正是数千年人类发展最璀璨的成就之一。

sents.en: The mathematical community has long-standing norms concerning the dissemination and peer review of results.
sents.zh: 数学界长期以来一直存在关于成果传播与同行评审的规范。

sents.en: These norms have been essential for the reliability, trustworthiness, and effectiveness of mathematical work.
sents.zh: 这些规范对于数学工作的可靠性、可信性和有效性至关重要。

sents.en: One of the most important scholarly norms in mathematics is that the authors of a paper should understand the mathematical argument of that paper, have verified its correctness themselves, and take full responsibility for the content.
sents.zh: 数学中最重要的学术规范之一是：论文作者应当理解该论文的数学论证，亲自验证其正确性，并对内容承担全部责任。

sents.en: Moreover, in the mathematical community, authors of works that significantly advance the field regularly give seminars at other institutions and talks at conferences, explaining their new developments and answering questions from colleagues.
sents.zh: 此外，在数学界，做出重大推进该领域工作的作者通常会定期在其他机构举办研讨会并在会议上作报告，解释他们的新进展并回答同行的问题。

sents.en: This all works towards developing the deepest possible human understanding of mathematics, which is one of the crowning glories of millennia of human development.
sents.zh: 这一切都有助于发展对数学尽可能深入的人类理解，而这正是数千年人类发展最璀璨的成就之一。

paragraphs.en: However, it is now the case that AI can output mathematical arguments in situations without the human who prompted it being able to understand the arguments, verify them, or take responsibility for them. We believe that human understanding of mathematics remains of paramount importance. How, in this new era, can we work towards a new paradigm that includes human understanding of mathematics as part of responsible scholarly output?
paragraphs.zh: 然而，现在的情况是，AI 可以在提示它的人类无法理解这些论证、无法验证这些论证、也无法为这些论证承担责任的情况下输出数学论证。 我们认为，人类对数学的理解仍然至关重要。 在这个新时代，我们如何才能走向一种将人类对数学的理解纳入负责任的学术成果之中的新范式？

sents.en: However, it is now the case that AI can output mathematical arguments in situations without the human who prompted it being able to understand the arguments, verify them, or take responsibility for them.
sents.zh: 然而，现在的情况是，AI 可以在提示它的人类无法理解这些论证、无法验证这些论证、也无法为这些论证承担责任的情况下输出数学论证。

sents.en: We believe that human understanding of mathematics remains of paramount importance.
sents.zh: 我们认为，人类对数学的理解仍然至关重要。

sents.en: How, in this new era, can we work towards a new paradigm that includes human understanding of mathematics as part of responsible scholarly output?
sents.zh: 在这个新时代，我们如何才能走向一种将人类对数学的理解纳入负责任的学术成果之中的新范式？

paragraphs.en: We asked the mathematical community for feedback about what it would mean for AI labs to responsibly release mathematical results 1 and received over 600 replies. Informed by these responses, we arrived at a set of recommendations, supported by a clear plurality of respondents, aimed at any AI lab whose models are likely to have a significant impact on mathematics. The overarching principles underlying these recommendations are the following.
paragraphs.zh: 我们向数学界征求了关于 AI 实验室负责任地发布数学成果 1 意味着什么的反馈，收到了 600 多条回复。 基于这些回复，我们提出了一套得到大多数受访者明确支持的建议，面向任何其模型可能对数学产生重大影响的 AI 实验室。 这些 recommendations 背后的总体原则如下。

sents.en: We asked the mathematical community for feedback about what it would mean for AI labs to responsibly release mathematical results 1 and received over 600 replies.
sents.zh: 我们向数学界征求了关于 AI 实验室负责任地发布数学成果 1 意味着什么的反馈，收到了 600 多条回复。

sents.en: Informed by these responses, we arrived at a set of recommendations, supported by a clear plurality of respondents, aimed at any AI lab whose models are likely to have a significant impact on mathematics.
sents.zh: 基于这些回复，我们提出了一套得到大多数受访者明确支持的建议，面向任何其模型可能对数学产生重大影响的 AI 实验室。

sents.en: The overarching principles underlying these recommendations are the following.
sents.zh: 这些 recommendations 背后的总体原则如下。

paragraphs.en: We present our recommendations themselves in Section 2, and in Section 3 we make some comments about access to powerful models.
paragraphs.zh: 我们在第 2 节中直接给出我们的建议，并在第 3 节中对强大模型的访问问题作一些评论。

paragraphs.en: We recommend two possible courses of action, depending on the level of human understanding that accompanies a result.
paragraphs.zh: 根据结果所伴随的人类理解程度，我们推荐两种可能的行动方案。

paragraphs.en: Papers for which there is a mathematician responsible who fully understands the content should follow the academic mathematical community’s traditional norms: the mathematician(s) concerned should post a preprint, submit a paper for peer review at a journal, and give talks to explain the work to other mathematicians.
paragraphs.zh: 对于有一位完全理解其内容的数学家负责的论文，应当遵循学术数学界的传统规范：相关数学家应发布预印本，将论文提交至期刊进行同行评审，并通过报告向其他数学家讲解这项工作。

paragraphs.en: The recommendations below are for labs that have AI mathematical output that is not understood by the people who prompted the AI systems. They are split into two parts. The first part is a set of proposed technical norms for the release of AI-generated mathematics. The second part is a recommendation that AI labs provide support for the additional mathematical activities that are needed for humans to be able to understand and assimilate their AI-generated mathematical output and identify possible applications of it.
paragraphs.zh: 以下建议适用于这样的情况：实验室拥有的 AI 数学产出是发出提示的人所无法理解的。 它们分为两部分。 第一部分是针对 AI 生成数学的发布提出的一套技术规范。 第二部分是一项建议：AI 实验室应为额外的数学活动提供支持，这些活动是人类理解并吸收其 AI 生成数学产出、以及识别其可能应用所必需的。

sents.en: The recommendations below are for labs that have AI mathematical output that is not understood by the people who prompted the AI systems.
sents.zh: 以下建议适用于这样的情况：实验室拥有的 AI 数学产出是发出提示的人所无法理解的。

sents.en: They are split into two parts.
sents.zh: 它们分为两部分。

sents.en: The first part is a set of proposed technical norms for the release of AI-generated mathematics.
sents.zh: 第一部分是针对 AI 生成数学的发布提出的一套技术规范。

sents.en: The second part is a recommendation that AI labs provide support for the additional mathematical activities that are needed for humans to be able to understand and assimilate their AI-generated mathematical output and identify possible applications of it.
sents.zh: 第二部分是一项建议：AI 实验室应为额外的数学活动提供支持，这些活动是人类理解并吸收其 AI 生成数学产出、以及识别其可能应用所必需的。

paragraphs.en: 1. With the help of LLMs, it is easy to make substantial improvements to the initial written version of an AI-generated result. The following actions should be carried out by the AI labs rather than left to mathematicians afterwards.
paragraphs.zh: 1. 借助大语言模型（LLM），我们可以轻松地对 AI 生成结果的初始书面版本做出大幅改进。 以下行动应当由 AI 实验室来执行，而不是留待数学家事后处理。

sents.en: With the help of LLMs, it is easy to make substantial improvements to the initial written version of an AI-generated result.
sents.zh: 借助大语言模型（LLM），我们可以轻松地对 AI 生成结果的初始书面版本做出大幅改进。

sents.en: The following actions should be carried out by the AI labs rather than left to mathematicians afterwards.
sents.zh: 以下行动应当由 AI 实验室来执行，而不是留待数学家事后处理。

paragraphs.en: (a) The literature should be scoured for any ideas that are related to the ideas in the proofs of the results released. Even if the AI lab’s model discovered those ideas independently, it should follow standard mathematical practice and cite the papers in which the ideas were first introduced.
paragraphs.zh: (a) 应当广泛查阅文献，寻找任何与已发布结果证明中所用思路相关的想法。 即使 AI 实验室的模型是独立发现这些想法的，它也应遵循标准数学惯例，引用首次提出这些想法的论文。

sents.en: (a) The literature should be scoured for any ideas that are related to the ideas in the proofs of the results released.
sents.zh: (a) 应当广泛查阅文献，寻找任何与已发布结果证明中所用思路相关的想法。

sents.en: Even if the AI lab’s model discovered those ideas independently, it should follow standard mathematical practice and cite the papers in which the ideas were first introduced.
sents.zh: 即使 AI 实验室的模型是独立发现这些想法的，它也应遵循标准数学惯例，引用首次提出这些想法的论文。

paragraphs.en: (b) The model, or some other model, should be prompted to produce a version of each proof that is written up in a style that follows the conventions of a traditional mathematical paper. They should contain friendly introductions and precise theorem statements and proofs. They should not be full of wordy reasoning and non-standard terminology that renders them virtually incomprehensible.
paragraphs.zh: (b) 应提示该模型或某个其他模型，将每条证明改写为符合传统数学论文惯例的风格。 它们应包含友好的引言以及精确的定理陈述和证明。 它们不应充斥着冗长的推理和非标准术语，以致几乎无法理解。

sents.en: (b) The model, or some other model, should be prompted to produce a version of each proof that is written up in a style that follows the conventions of a traditional mathematical paper.
sents.zh: (b) 应提示该模型或某个其他模型，将每条证明改写为符合传统数学论文惯例的风格。

sents.en: They should contain friendly introductions and precise theorem statements and proofs.
sents.zh: 它们应包含友好的引言以及精确的定理陈述和证明。

sents.en: They should not be full of wordy reasoning and non-standard terminology that renders them virtually incomprehensible.
sents.zh: 它们不应充斥着冗长的推理和非标准术语，以致几乎无法理解。

paragraphs.en: The current abilities of LLMs may not be able to reproduce the level of attribution or quality of exposition that we expect of mathematicians, and thus more important work from mathematicians after release may be needed to reach this standard. If so, this should be supported as described in Step II. However, inability to reach a high standard does not absolve AI labs of the responsibility to do the best they can with their models on the two points above.
paragraphs.zh: LLM 目前的能力可能还无法再现我们对数学家所期望的归因水平或阐述质量，因此发布之后可能仍需要数学家做更重要的工作才能达到这一标准。 如果是这样，应当按照步骤 II 中所述的方式予以支持。 然而，无法达到高标准并不能免除 AI 实验室在其模型能力范围内尽力做好上述两点的责任。

sents.en: The current abilities of LLMs may not be able to reproduce the level of attribution or quality of exposition that we expect of mathematicians, and thus more important work from mathematicians after release may be needed to reach this standard.
sents.zh: LLM 目前的能力可能还无法再现我们对数学家所期望的归因水平或阐述质量，因此发布之后可能仍需要数学家做更重要的工作才能达到这一标准。

sents.en: If so, this should be supported as described in Step II.
sents.zh: 如果是这样，应当按照步骤 II 中所述的方式予以支持。

sents.en: However, inability to reach a high standard does not absolve AI labs of the responsibility to do the best they can with their models on the two points above.
sents.zh: 然而，无法达到高标准并不能免除 AI 实验室在其模型能力范围内尽力做好上述两点的责任。

paragraphs.en: 2. When results are announced, they should be deposited in a timely manner in appropriate scholarly repositories. These should not be controlled by any AI lab and should guarantee certain standards, including that submissions have a persistent citable identifier and that subsequent modifications are appropriately recorded. For AI-generated results, it would be particularly useful if the repository allows for comments on papers.
paragraphs.zh: 2. 当结果公布时，应及时将其存入合适的学术存储库。 这些存储库不应由任何 AI 实验室控制，并应保证一定的标准，包括提交的内容拥有持久可引用的标识符，且后续修改会被适当记录。 对于 AI 生成的结果，如果存储库允许对论文发表评论，将尤为有用。

sents.en: When results are announced, they should be deposited in a timely manner in appropriate scholarly repositories.
sents.zh: 当结果公布时，应及时将其存入合适的学术存储库。

sents.en: These should not be controlled by any AI lab and should guarantee certain standards, including that submissions have a persistent citable identifier and that subsequent modifications are appropriately recorded.
sents.zh: 这些存储库不应由任何 AI 实验室控制，并应保证一定的标准，包括提交的内容拥有持久可引用的标识符，且后续修改会被适当记录。

sents.en: For AI-generated results, it would be particularly useful if the repository allows for comments on papers.
sents.zh: 对于 AI 生成的结果，如果存储库允许对论文发表评论，将尤为有用。

paragraphs.en: We strongly recommend that AI labs refrain from treating the release of mathematical results as marketing vehicles to promote their models, ignoring the substantial negative externalities that this practice inflicts on the mathematical community.
paragraphs.zh: 我们强烈建议各人工智能实验室不要将数学成果的发布当作推广其模型的营销工具，而无视这种做法给数学界带来的巨大负面外部性。

paragraphs.en: 3. For each result released, the AI lab should make public the name of the model, the prompts used, a (summarized) chain of thought, the time taken, and the estimated cost of computation. Releasing additional material that sheds light on the scientific process that produced the results, such as the initial LLM outputs before they were cleaned up (as recommended in (1) above), is strongly encouraged.
paragraphs.zh: 3. 对于发布的每项结果，人工智能实验室应公开模型名称、所使用的提示词、（经过总结的）思维链、所用时间以及估算的计算成本。 强烈建议发布有助于揭示得出结果之科学过程的补充材料，例如在清理之前的初始大语言模型输出（如上文第 (1) 条所建议的那样）。

sents.en: For each result released, the AI lab should make public the name of the model, the prompts used, a (summarized) chain of thought, the time taken, and the estimated cost of computation.
sents.zh: 对于发布的每项结果，人工智能实验室应公开模型名称、所使用的提示词、（经过总结的）思维链、所用时间以及估算的计算成本。

sents.en: Releasing additional material that sheds light on the scientific process that produced the results, such as the initial LLM outputs before they were cleaned up (as recommended in (1) above), is strongly encouraged.
sents.zh: 强烈建议发布有助于揭示得出结果之科学过程的补充材料，例如在清理之前的初始大语言模型输出（如上文第 (1) 条所建议的那样）。

paragraphs.en: 4. As far as possible, a proof released by an AI lab should be formalized. Formalization artifacts should meet community standards, including having copyright headers, a challenge file for comparator, and a formalization.yaml. It would be helpful to include machine-readable metadata correlating the natural language and formal artifacts. Where formalization would lead to unacceptable delays, the formalization status of the paper should be clearly stated. For example, perhaps it has been formalized modulo standard results that are accepted by the community
paragraphs.zh: 4. 在尽可能的情况下，AI 实验室发布的证明应当被形式化。 形式化产物应符合社区标准，包括包含版权声明头、用于比较器的挑战文件，以及 formalization.yaml 文件。 包含将自然语言与形式化产物关联起来的机器可读元数据会很有帮助。 在形式化会导致不可接受的延迟的情况下，论文的形式化状态应当被清楚地说明。 例如，也许该证明已经相对于社区公认的标准化结果完成了形式化。

sents.en: As far as possible, a proof released by an AI lab should be formalized.
sents.zh: 在尽可能的情况下，AI 实验室发布的证明应当被形式化。

sents.en: Formalization artifacts should meet community standards, including having copyright headers, a challenge file for comparator, and a formalization.yaml.
sents.zh: 形式化产物应符合社区标准，包括包含版权声明头、用于比较器的挑战文件，以及 formalization.yaml 文件。

sents.en: It would be helpful to include machine-readable metadata correlating the natural language and formal artifacts.
sents.zh: 包含将自然语言与形式化产物关联起来的机器可读元数据会很有帮助。

sents.en: Where formalization would lead to unacceptable delays, the formalization status of the paper should be clearly stated.
sents.zh: 在形式化会导致不可接受的延迟的情况下，论文的形式化状态应当被清楚地说明。

sents.en: For example, perhaps it has been formalized modulo standard results that are accepted by the community
sents.zh: 例如，也许该证明已经相对于社区公认的标准化结果完成了形式化。

paragraphs.en: 5. Each time a solution to a problem is released, it should be clearly documented how exactly AI came to be used on that particular problem. If many results are released at once, then in addition to the results themselves a further document should be written and made public that references all of the released results and explains how many other problems of comparable difficulty the models tried and failed to solve, as well as how the problems were chosen.
paragraphs.zh: 5. 每次发布某个问题的解决方案时，都应清楚地记录人工智能究竟是如何被用于该特定问题的。 如果一次发布多个结果，那么除了结果本身之外，还应撰写并公开一份额外文件，引用所有已发布的结果，并说明模型尝试解决但未能解决的可比难度的其他问题有多少，以及这些问题是如何被选定的。

sents.en: Each time a solution to a problem is released, it should be clearly documented how exactly AI came to be used on that particular problem.
sents.zh: 每次发布某个问题的解决方案时，都应清楚地记录人工智能究竟是如何被用于该特定问题的。

sents.en: If many results are released at once, then in addition to the results themselves a further document should be written and made public that references all of the released results and explains how many other problems of comparable difficulty the models tried and failed to solve, as well as how the problems were chosen.
sents.zh: 如果一次发布多个结果，那么除了结果本身之外，还应撰写并公开一份额外文件，引用所有已发布的结果，并说明模型尝试解决但未能解决的可比难度的其他问题有多少，以及这些问题是如何被选定的。

paragraphs.en: One of our principles is that AI labs have a responsibility to provide support, including funding, for the development of human understanding of the AI mathematical output that they release. Here we give more detail about what such support might be used for, though the ultimate decision about which particular efforts are supported should be taken neither by this group nor by AI labs, but by separate, already existing nonprofit institutions that have established processes for distributing funding. The scope of the appropriate level of support should depend on the importance and complexity of the released AI output, as these features determine the amount of work that will be needed to support human understanding of the output.
paragraphs.zh: 我们的原则之一是：AI 实验室有责任为促进人类对其发布的 AI 数学输出的理解提供支持，包括资金支持。 在此，我们更详细地说明这些支持可能用于哪些方面，但关于具体支持哪些工作的最终决定，既不应由本群体作出，也不应由 AI 实验室作出，而应由独立的、已经存在的非营利机构作出，这些机构拥有成熟的资金分配流程。 适当支持水平的范围应取决于所发布 AI 输出的重要性和复杂程度，因为这些特征决定了对人类理解该输出所需支持的工作量。

sents.en: One of our principles is that AI labs have a responsibility to provide support, including funding, for the development of human understanding of the AI mathematical output that they release.
sents.zh: 我们的原则之一是：AI 实验室有责任为促进人类对其发布的 AI 数学输出的理解提供支持，包括资金支持。

sents.en: Here we give more detail about what such support might be used for, though the ultimate decision about which particular efforts are supported should be taken neither by this group nor by AI labs, but by separate, already existing nonprofit institutions that have established processes for distributing funding.
sents.zh: 在此，我们更详细地说明这些支持可能用于哪些方面，但关于具体支持哪些工作的最终决定，既不应由本群体作出，也不应由 AI 实验室作出，而应由独立的、已经存在的非营利机构作出，这些机构拥有成熟的资金分配流程。

sents.en: The scope of the appropriate level of support should depend on the importance and complexity of the released AI output, as these features determine the amount of work that will be needed to support human understanding of the output.
sents.zh: 适当支持水平的范围应取决于所发布 AI 输出的重要性和复杂程度，因为这些特征决定了对人类理解该输出所需支持的工作量。

paragraphs.en: It should be understood that the acceptance of such support by the mathematical community would not be conferring legitimacy on the practices of the AI labs. Rather, it would be asking the AI labs to make an appropriate contribution to fulfilling their responsibility towards the development of human understanding of their AI output.
paragraphs.zh: 应当理解的是，数学界接受这种支持并不意味着承认人工智能实验室相关做法的合法性。 相反，这是要求人工智能实验室作出适当贡献，以履行它们对促进人类理解其人工智能输出所负有的责任。

sents.en: It should be understood that the acceptance of such support by the mathematical community would not be conferring legitimacy on the practices of the AI labs.
sents.zh: 应当理解的是，数学界接受这种支持并不意味着承认人工智能实验室相关做法的合法性。

sents.en: Rather, it would be asking the AI labs to make an appropriate contribution to fulfilling their responsibility towards the development of human understanding of their AI output.
sents.zh: 相反，这是要求人工智能实验室作出适当贡献，以履行它们对促进人类理解其人工智能输出所负有的责任。

paragraphs.en: The use of proprietary internal models by AI labs to do mathematical research risks creating a two-tier system where labs outrun the rest of the field, effectively alienating the mathematical community from its own discipline.
paragraphs.zh: 人工智能实验室使用专有内部模型进行数学研究，有可能造成一个两级体系，使实验室领先于领域的其他部分，实际上将数学界与其自身学科隔离开来。

paragraphs.en: As for publicly available models, unequal access due to economic and other factors risks establishing a multi-tier hierarchy across the mathematical world and greatly exacerbating existing inequalities that arise from institutional wealth and technological privilege.
paragraphs.zh: 至于公开可用的模型，因经济及其他因素导致的获取不平等，有可能在整个数学界建立起多层级体系，并极大地加剧因机构财富和技术特权而产生的既有不平等。

paragraphs.en: We therefore advise the AI labs to grant the global mathematical community broad, equitable access to their publicly available models: this is a way both to accelerate progress and to ensure wide access to it. Mathematics advances primarily through collective verification, conceptual synthesis, and shared intuition, none of which can thrive when some instruments generating frontier results are accessible only to a select few.
paragraphs.zh: 因此，我们建议各 AI 实验室向全球数学界提供广泛、公平地访问其公开可用模型的途径：这既能加速进展，也能确保进展得到广泛获取。 数学的进步主要依靠集体验证、概念综合与共享直觉，而当产生前沿成果的某些工具只有少数人才能使用时，这一切都无法蓬勃发展。

sents.en: We therefore advise the AI labs to grant the global mathematical community broad, equitable access to their publicly available models: this is a way both to accelerate progress and to ensure wide access to it.
sents.zh: 因此，我们建议各 AI 实验室向全球数学界提供广泛、公平地访问其公开可用模型的途径：这既能加速进展，也能确保进展得到广泛获取。

sents.en: Mathematics advances primarily through collective verification, conceptual synthesis, and shared intuition, none of which can thrive when some instruments generating frontier results are accessible only to a select few.
sents.zh: 数学的进步主要依靠集体验证、概念综合与共享直觉，而当产生前沿成果的某些工具只有少数人才能使用时，这一切都无法蓬勃发展。
